subtitle: Architectural Career Design
teachers:
KITORA Hisataka
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: To acquire the ability to understand real-world trends in architecture-related fields and to determine one's own future direction based on a vision of future career paths. In this subject, students gain an understanding of careers and specialized areas in the field of architecture, and areas of study in the two courses of the Department of Architecture. Students also summarize a study plan with a view to designing one's own career using logical sentences.
advice:
1. Understanding of the industry, self-analysis and goal setting
Research trends in technology and occupations related to the field of architecture and set goals for employment.

2. Understanding the contents of the specialized area for each course
Understand the specialized areas of the Design and Engineering courses. Understand the relationship between the areas of study, laboratories, and job functions of each course.

3. Creating a study plan
After considering the course selection, clarify your own learning goals and summarize your future study plan.

              To acquire the ability to understand real-world trends in architecture-related fields and to determine one's own future direction based on a vision of future career paths. In this subject, students gain an understanding of careers and specialized areas in the field of architecture, and areas of study in the two courses of the Department of Architecture. Students also summarize a study plan with a view to designing one's own career using logical sentences.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Understanding of the industry, self-analysis and goal setting
Research trends in technology and occupations related to the field of architecture and set goals for employment.

2. Understanding the contents of the specialized area for each course
Understand the specialized areas of the Design and Engineering courses. Understand the relationship between the areas of study, laboratories, and job functions of each course.

3. Creating a study plan
After considering the course selection, clarify your own learning goals and summarize your future study plan.
